notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Hi!
The game is finally out of endless development, and we are happy to present it to you.
The game features three love interests, 12 endings, and 30+ CG.
What's next. A new chapter of  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111200/Bride_Of_Darkness/]Bride Of Darkness[/url] is in process and will be out sometime around February/March.

*We have found that there are some translation issues and are already looking into it!

notes.title: First Chapter of Bride Of Darkness!
notes.content:
Hello! The Bride Of Darkness otome novella will be released in early access soon. So far only the first chapter, but the second one is already in development and will be out soon. 
Tentatively it's scheduled for release on April 13th, add it to your Wishlist, so you won't miss it! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111200/Bride_Of_Darkness/]Bride Of Darkness[/url]

notes.title: Demo is update
notes.content:
Hi!
A small update of the demo!
What's new?
- 3 CG
- 3 BG
- 2 chibi scenes
- 1 frame
Also now you can't rewind the election back. This will be done in the full version in the future.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Release DEMO!
notes.content:
Hi!
We are pleased to announce that the novel has a demo version, which you can download from the page of the main game!
In the demo, you'll get to know the characters and maybe you can decide on your future love interest.
Game release: early 2023.
Have fun playing!
